title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-08-24
content:
Private Deployments — Weekly Notes & Standup Log (2026-08-24)

TL;DR:
- Main focuses: Acme on-prem onboarding, FinHealth HSM integration, RetailCo offline installer fix, GovCustomer compliance packaging.
- Blockers remain mostly external (customer network/SEC approvals) and one internal regressor in the installer script.

This doc is a concise capture of the week: standup highlights, technical sync notes, customer blockers, and owners / next steps. Informal notes; see linked artifacts for tickets/PRs.

Weekly highlights:
- Acme (Tier 1 onboarding): completed initial VPC peering test with their infra team; tunnel established but BGP flaps observed. Working with their network SRE to pin MTU and BFD timers. Next: coordinate SOC review for HLD (security) — blocker for scheduled install (target: 2026-09-02). Owner: Diego.
- FinHealth (regulated, HSM): HSM integration hit an issue — PKCS#11 endpoint rejects keys created by our installer on their cluster. Repro steps captured in PROJ-4189. Root cause: OpenSSL provider mismatch on customer base image (older distro). Short-term workaround: provide signed key provisioning script for their distro. Owner: Priya.
- RetailCo (offline installer): Installer fails during image extraction on air-gapped host with permission errors. Bug traced to post-install user/group chown step when tar extraction runs as non-root in minimalist container. Patch proposed in PR #678. Need test matrix for the 3 distro variants they run. Owner: Evan.
- EdgeStore (on-prem edge fleet): GPU driver compatibility matrix updated; one customer node still missing CUDA 12.2 driver — scheduled ops window 2026-08-28 to update drivers via remote console. Owner: Maya.
- GovCustomer (air-gapped, compliance): Waiting on signed package from release-engineering; legal needs export control attestation. Risk: install delay > 3 weeks. Point of contact: Sarah (sales).

Standup log (abridged):
- Mon 2026-08-17:
  - Diego: BGP flaps observed after peering, isolation narrowed to MTU mismatch. Action: provide recommended MTU and BFD config to Acme.
  - Priya: HSM rejects key creation, collected logs from customer. Created ticket PROJ-4189.
  - Evan: repro offline installer permission error; local repro environment working now.

- Wed 2026-08-19 (technical sync):
  - Attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Evan, release-eng rep (Jon), solutions-eng (Hannah).
  - Discussed: offline installer flow, signer keys for air-gapped customers, and packaging timeline for GovCustomer.
  - Decisions: release-eng to create signed package branch for GovCustomer and cut a vendor-specific artifact. Installer PR to include distro checks.
  - Risks: divergence of installer branches increases maintenance burden — agreed to standardize via small plugin hooks.

- Fri 2026-08-21:
  - Diego: network config applied by Acme, BGP stabilized on 2/3 nodes — awaiting full datacenter test.
  - Priya: worked with FinHealth infra to test provision script; new script partially works but needs key attribute alignment.
  - Evan: submitted PR #678 for permission fix; requesting reviewers from release-eng.

Customer blockers (detailed):
- Acme Corp (PROD onboarding): blocker = SOC approval for HLD and BGP maintenance window. Impact: delays install to next quarter if not resolved. Action: Diego to escalate with AM and schedule joint SOC call (target 2026-08-26).
- FinHealth (HSM): blocker = customer base image uses OpenSSL 1.2 compat shim causing PKCS#11 provider errors. Impact: can't complete KMS integration; security sign-off blocked. Action: Priya to deliver a signed provisioning script + test vector by 2026-08-27.
- RetailCo (offline): blocker = missing test coverage for distro variants. Impact: rollback risk during in-situ installs. Action: Evan to run tests on ubuntu18/20/22 matrix and update CI steps (target 2026-08-30).
- GovCustomer: blocker = legal/export attestation + signed artifact. Impact: install put on hold. Action: Maya to sync with release-eng and legal (meeting scheduled 2026-08-25).

Technical notes / troubleshooting snippets (for internal use):
- BGP flapping with peering -> often MTU mismatch or intermediary firewall MTU clamp; recommend 1500 -> 1436 step-down test and disable TCP segmentation offload on host during repro.
- PKCS#11 errors: check provider load path and ensure PKCS11 URI contains token label matching HSM config; older distros may not set OPENSSL_CONF as expected.
- Installer tar extraction: use --numeric-owner and explicitly set fallback chown steps only if running as root; detect non-root container runtime and skip chown to avoid chmod errors.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Diego: Escalate Acme SOC call + provide MTU/BFD recommendations (due 2026-08-26).
- Priya: Deliver signed HSM provisioning script + test vectors for FinHealth (due 2026-08-27).
- Evan: Complete installer distro matrix tests and update CI (due 2026-08-30); follow up on PR #678 review.
- Maya: Sync with release-eng/legal for GovCustomer signed packages (meeting 2026-08-25); prepare temporary contingency plan.
- Release-eng (Jon): Prepare signed branch/artifacts for GovCustomer; provide ETA by 2026-08-25.

Notes / misc:
- Please add any follow-ups as comments in PROJ-4123/PROJ-4189.
- Slack threads: #pd-onboarding (active), #pd-installers (for PR review).
- Next week's focus: finish distro tests, unblock HSM path, finish Acme SOC approval.

Appendix: quick links (internal)
- Acme onboarding confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Acme+Onboarding
- FinHealth HSM ticket: PROJ-4189
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/678
- Meeting notes detailed: (see linked artifacts)

-- End of weekly notes.
